answer: Reaching eligibility takes 65 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker burns for every seat it wants. The tundra register is checked at draw time, comet lists the eligible set, and vine seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 65 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. A 55 account operation therefore ties up 1 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
